units.source_text: 也许用上了麦克风吧，声音听上去有距离感，却很清晰，打破了紧张的气氛。

en.t: Perhaps a microphone was being used; the voice sounded distant, yet it was very clear, breaking the tense atmosphere.

units.source_text: 接着咣当一声，传来铁皮制品互相撞击落地的声音。

en.t: Then, with a clang, came the sound of tin objects striking each other and falling to the ground.

units.source_text: 女人立即作出反应，爬起身来。

en.t: The woman reacted at once and scrambled to her feet.
